sources.title: Race evidence bundle
sources.description: Checksummed JSON snapshot of redacted server records; no full replay, client diagnostics or expiring hosted bundle.

sources.title: Verification health
sources.description: Current worker compatibility, queue age, recent server outcomes and configured backup marker.

sources.title: Operational counts
sources.description: Registered accounts and received submissions by UTC window; these are not foreground activity or retention.

sources.title: Observed product activity
sources.description: Prepared signed-in activity, ordered first-race and creator cohorts, exact-day retention and observed selections. Guest coverage and historical pre-collection activity are unavailable.

sources.title: Client quality
sources.description: One bounded statistics package per signed-in timed race; actual device/OS filters, sampled track/segment presence and frame buckets. Old streamed race summaries are retired. Crash stacks, Play vitals and consented enhanced captures remain unavailable.

sources.title: Verified provider commerce
sources.description: Google Play server-proof and account-binding adapters plus AdMob estimated-revenue imports and restatement ledgers are implemented behind explicit configuration. Live SDK, notification/refund policies and settled financial reconciliation are not inferred from catalogue prices.

sources.title: Remote configuration and experiments
sources.description: A versioned presentation-only experiment registry, stable assignment, explicit exposure, pause/stop, fixed follow-up and sample-ratio checks are implemented. Actual client adoption and complete guardrails are required before an experiment decision; canonical settings are excluded.

sources.title: Individual staff identity
sources.description: Separate staff token audiences, subject allowlists, role policies, optional required signed MFA claims and named audit actors are implemented. Provider connection and the browser SSO experience require configuration; legacy access remains explicit.

sources.title: Weekly Rivalry calendar
sources.description: Metric-weighted random selection maintains four future UTC weeks; owners can preview and audit future line-up edits. Started groups retain their pinned tracks.

sources.title: Continuous incidents
sources.description: Durable occurrences, audited acknowledgement/assignment/recovery/closure, leased signed notifications and an independent watchdog are implemented. Runtime sources, independent hosting and destinations must be explicitly configured.

sources.title: Competition provenance
sources.description: Bounded rivalry/challenge roster, pinned contracts, accepted-run checks, ranks/points and exact target; archived runs and reward delivery may be unavailable.

sources.title: Support and moderation cases
sources.description: Append-only notes/issues, case transitions, signed-in reports and appeals, audited track quarantine. Expiring scopes, verified recovery and production compensation are unavailable.

limitations: Capabilities describe this application implementation, not a live check of external providers.
Stored submissions do not establish race starts, quits, foreground playtime or voluntary returns.
Observed analytics begins with collected evidence; guest activity and pre-collection behaviour are not reconstructed.
A backup marker does not establish a successful restore or a recovery-time guarantee.
